title: 8Z Compression / MDL Core Context — Light
purpose: Compact 8Z coding/codec context for MDL, audit, exactness, and multi-candidate decision patterns.

blocks.title: MDL selection pattern
blocks.text: 8Z code organizes compression candidates as MDLCandidate objects with payload length, file length, family, method, and payload. The system tests alternatives and lets measured MDL/cost decide.

blocks.title: Audit trail
blocks.text: MDLAuditLog records decision id, scope, candidate sizes/times, winner method, winner payload bytes, and total timing. MentalArena should mirror this: every LLM/stage decision should be auditable.

blocks.title: Exactness and manifests
blocks.text: 8Z style values exact round-trip, hashes, manifests, deterministic decoding, clear versioning, and conservative file/container semantics. Claims should be backed by reproducible artifacts.

blocks.title: Hybrid audit stance
blocks.text: The 8Z encoder was explicitly framed as a hybrid audit with BD concepts and AI architect/reviewer roles. MentalArena should preserve author/contributor lineage and separate architects, coders, reviewers, and final human decisions.

usage_instruction: Use only what is relevant. Cite CTX ids when relying on this context. If context is insufficient or conflicts with the task, say so explicitly.
